genZNote: One virus, many jobs: pink eye, the common cold, croup, and stomach bugs can all trace back to different adenovirus types.

morphology.shape: Non-enveloped icosahedral virion with characteristic fiber projections

habitat.naturalHabitat: Human respiratory, ocular, and gastrointestinal epithelium
habitat.hostAssociation: Humans are the primary host and reservoir; over 50 serotypes cause a wide range of clinical syndromes
habitat.reservoir: Infected humans; environmentally stable on surfaces and in water (including swimming pools)

microscopy.stain: Not applicable (electron microscopy only in research settings)
microscopy.appearance: Non-enveloped icosahedral capsid with distinctive fiber projections on EM

culture.growthCharacteristics: Grows in various cell lines producing a characteristic 'grape-like cluster' cytopathic effect

identificationClues: Non-enveloped DNA virus — notably resistant to alcohol-based disinfectants and can survive on surfaces and in chlorinated pool water
Extremely broad clinical range depending on serotype: pharyngoconjunctival fever, epidemic keratoconjunctivitis, croup/bronchiolitis/pneumonia, and gastroenteritis (types 40/41)
Diagnosed by PCR or antigen testing; rapid antigen tests are commonly used for adenoviral conjunctivitis
A well-known cause of outbreaks in swimming pools, daycares, and military recruit barracks

clinicalImportance.transmission: Respiratory droplets, direct contact, fecal-oral route, and contaminated water (e.g., swimming pools) or fomites
clinicalImportance.epidemiology: One of the most common causes of childhood respiratory illness and viral conjunctivitis worldwide; environmentally hardy compared to enveloped respiratory viruses
clinicalImportance.labSignificance: Non-enveloped structure explains its relative resistance to alcohol-based hand sanitizers, an important infection-control teaching point

examFacts.keyBiochemicalReaction: Not applicable — diagnosed by PCR/antigen testing
examFacts.importantDisease: Pharyngoconjunctival fever, epidemic keratoconjunctivitis, respiratory illness
examFacts.distinguishingFeature: Non-enveloped DNA virus with unusually broad tissue tropism and environmental hardiness (resists alcohol-based disinfectants)
